posts.title_en: Recommended guide for new and returning players
posts.summary_en: A long guide (2026-10-01). Purchases first: Ad Removal, the Crumble Pass (check its remaining days), the Unique gear pack at oven 10, the 55,000 KRW Special Sugarcoating membership. Gold has one use, Resolve (ATK, then HP, then DEF). Cookie EXP is refunded in full on reset, so spend it freely. Use coin, EXP and research-stone time tickets only when a stage is stuck, since they grow with the stage. Mileage: daily dungeon keys (coin > dough > research stone > EXP, rune) > Arena tickets > Stellar. Guild shop: Ceylon > Syrup > Chocosteel > Stellar. Stage gear: a pure-power (뻥투) preset to meet the recommended power, and an accuracy/focus preset (~900 accuracy past stage 100). Gnome Lab, 'the system with the biggest spec gains': push special research up to 19 taking only 2, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 19; when stones run short, level the lowest ATK-amplification basic nodes, then the HP ones; 'each finished research lets a stuck stage clear'. Speed-ups are best used while the research-stone dungeon is at 360–500, when stones outrun research. Guild research takes free and Crystal donations, the Crystal price rising with each donation and resetting daily; guilds usually ask under 8,140 Crystals a day.

datapoints.note: '연구가 하나 완료될 때마다 안 밀리던 스테이지가 밀릴 정도로 상승폭이 커서' — a claim, no figure

advice.text: Buy Ad Removal, the Crumble Pass, the Unique gear pack and the 5.5 membership first.
Special research to 19 first (only 2, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 19), then the lowest ATK-amp basic nodes, then HP.
Resolve in ATK → HP → DEF order; gold has no other use.
Keep a pure-power stage preset to meet recommended power and an accuracy preset (~900).
Guild shop: Ceylon > Syrup Metal > Chocosteel > Stellar.
